doc: The shell's and the kernel's commands, by number (@xpute/core/ipc/cmd.ts:
`major << 8 | minor`), and the packet each carries — an XTP branch whose
children are listed in order. A message's tag is its subject: a chunk's
id where there is one, so no packet repeats it. A command with no
children carries no packet.
The same number is a command on the submission ring and a signal on the
completion ring (its `RES` clear): a chunk the shell creates is a chunk
it registers, a chunk the kernel creates is one it mounted. The direction
is the ring.

Mechanism rather than the world's: numbered here while this is the one
table. The pool a command is about is its packet's first child, so a
release can be asked about as well as sent. The pools are the kernel's
sections, made at boot: fixed 0, page 1, mesh 2 (pxl_core::memory).

entries.name: POOL_READ
doc: tag call · [pool u32] → result: where its stat is, twelve words in
BuddyStat's first twelve fields' order, at a fixed address

entries.name: POOL_ACQUIRE
doc: tag call · [pool u32, bytes u32] → result: the block's address, 0 when
the range is used up or the request is larger than a region

entries.name: POOL_RELEASE
doc: [pool u32, at u32, bytes u32] — the block returned; EINVAL for one the
pool does not hold or holds already

entries.name: POOL_FREE
doc: tag call · [pool u32, at u32, bytes u32] → result: 1 where the block is
free, 0 where not
A volume painted, baked and scanned by hand, as apps/web/src/reference/
does to hold the module to the TypeScript pipeline it replaced; the live
build composes, bakes and scans inside the scheduler. One bake and one
scan are open at a time, so neither names a subject. A step's result is
a StepResult.

u32[]]: BAND_WORDS words a band — band_z, the material, layer and
sub-cell lanes' addresses (0 for none), the extras' count and their five
lanes' addresses — valid until the volume is painted again

entries.name: VOLUME_DELETE

entries.section: the world's turn: the shell's events in, the kernel's asks out

entries.name: WORLD_CREATE
doc: [app_env str, build_time str, build_id str, build_number str, published_tiles bool,
handheld bool] — the shell's boot: what the bundler defined and the device; the
object store loaded

entries.name: WORLD_UPDATE
doc: [width f64, height f64, dpr f64, delta_s f64, geolocation bool, orientation bool,
orientation_permission bool, slice_ms f64, batch_ms f64, frame_ms f64, credits u32]
— the central scheduler's strobe: the effects' turn, then the tick's phases on the
grant, the fetches within the credits; the viewport in CSS pixels. The turn leaves
its signals on the completion ring, drawn by the kernel, and last this command's own
as a signal: [asked bool, used_ms f64, settled bool, draws u32] — a turn after this one
was asked for, what the tick spent, whether it ran on the batch quantum, and the
draws it listed

entries.name: WORLD_ACTION

entries.name: WORLD_LONG_FRAME
doc: send · [source u32 (0 loaf, 1 longtask), t f64, duration f64, blocking f64, script f64, render f64]
A frame that blocked the event loop past 50ms, as the shell's own
observer saw it. The kernel cannot see one: a long animation frame is
a browser measurement of the whole task, and the tick is only part of
it. The ledger keeps it beside the frames it did measure.

doc: [left f64, top f64, width f64, height f64] — the canvas's client rect

entries.name: INPUT_WHEEL
